skills.description:
Generate or rewrite a classic fairy tale or picture-book story constrained to a
specific vocabulary level. Use this skill when the user wants a story adapted to
a stated vocabulary standard — e.g. "小学三年级", "CEFR A2", "初中", "雅思 5.5",
"KET", "托福 60" — based on either the Chinese compulsory-education English
syllabus or mainstream English proficiency frameworks (CEFR, Cambridge, TOEFL,
IELTS). The skill requires the user to specify BOTH (1) the target vocabulary
level and (2) the source tale/picture book, then rewrites the story using only
words within that level's allowed vocabulary and verifies the result with a
checker script.
skills.description_zh:
根据用户指定的语言等级，对经典童话或绘本进行原创性复述。生成的英文文本在词汇和语法上严格匹配目标等级，确保该水平的学习者能够顺畅阅读。
支持的分级标准：
中国义务教育英语词汇标准（小学 / 初中 / 高中）
国际主流英语水平框架：CEFR（A1–C2）、剑桥（YLE/KET/PET/FCE/CAE/CPE）、TOEFL、IELTS
输出说明：
输出语言为英文（词汇标准基于英语词汇体系）
保留原故事的角色、设定和情节主线
仅使用目标等级范围内的词汇及相应难度的语法结构
skills.name: 分级词汇复述故事
